changed: Added bench:resources and deterministic metric tests to check.
Reconciled the product brief, architecture, resource guide and integrated switching acceptance.
Retained initial failures, isolation diagnostics, three passing full runs and an expected retained-memory regression failure.
summary: Replaced the unreachable absolute 50 MiB idle RSS target with same-host Node baseline overhead, separate stopped/running CPU criteria and bounded repeated-workload growth.
A source-only real-controller benchmark records reproducible workload, provenance, raw samples, margin and verified owned-process cleanup.
Reused bounded procfs buffers and batched disk log writes reduce allocation pressure while preserving process-resource aggregation, log order, rotation and finalization.
title: Measured baseline-relative controller resource budgets
validation: Implementation 8a0d5d0 incorporates merged PR #20 / c331a13; pnpm check passes 239 application tests plus 3 metric tests, and pnpm build passes.
Three independent real-controller runs on Node v24.19.0 pass all RSS/CPU/growth criteria; post-cycle RSS is 109.8-122.4 MiB and growth is 15.75-28.75 MiB. Smallest growth margin is 3.25 MiB.
A bounded 128 MiB retained-memory injection fails both memory checks on the same bundle (250.0 MiB RSS), exits 1 as expected and cleans up gracefully.
pnpm test:integration passes 11 tests; pnpm test:ui passes 5; pnpm test:e2e passes 2 real-controller browser tests.

Original implementations fail focused regression tests for 120 concurrent process reads and 2001 per-line disk writes. Fixed behavior passes, including rotation, write failure, ordering and close flushing.
Hub fmt/validate and git diff --check pass. Broader owner workflow and continuous slow-disk pressure are not claimed.
